regime_context: The Canada/TSX rotation detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the clear leader with full breadth and trend-gate eligibility; gold miners and banks follow, while the rotation is broad and not one-directional. Cross-sectional momentum has no forward alpha, and the only validated edge is drawdown control from the absolute trend gate, so any leans are low-conviction, risk-oriented allocations.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) closing rank score gap vs Base Metals to <0.1 with sustained breadth >0.9 would signal a potential leadership handoff; retire watch if gap widens beyond 0.5 again.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: As the top-ranked theme with full breadth, durability above 0.7, and absolute trend gate eligibility, it currently exhibits strong trend-following characteristics for risk control, but no return forecasting edge. Low-conviction overweight while the trend holds.
theses.dissent: Copper demand fears from a global slowdown and mean-reversion could reverse leadership quickly; the trend gate only reduces drawdown risk, not drawdown itself.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by >5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners hold second rank with high durability (0.79, trend-class hurst), full breadth, and no crowding; trend gate eligibility supports a risk-aware allocation in a precious metals environment.
theses.dissent: Gold price drops or a risk-on rotation would undermine the theme; the trend signal may lag a sharp reversal.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the TSX by >4% over 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks 15th with negative momentum score, remains crowded, and despite a trend gate eligibility, the combination of low rank and crowding warrants avoidance for risk management, not a fade.
theses.dissent: A sudden AI-driven catalyst could reignite tech leadership; the trend gate may protect against entry at a low point.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the TSX by >5% over the next 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
